top news.title: Anthropic launches Opus 4.8, saying it's “more likely to flag uncertainties about its work and less likely to make unsupported claims”, at the same price as 4.7

tweets.author: @bcherny
tweets.text: Claude Opus 4.8 is out today. It's our strongest coding model yet: up on SWE-bench Pro (from 64.3 to 69.2) and noticeably more honest about its own work. It tells you when it's unsure and catches its own bugs instead of declaring victory early. Same price as 4.7.

tweets.author: @teortaxestex
tweets.text: ...this is quite crushing. People unsubscribing from Ant will crawl back. Things are beginning to go very fast. And yes it feels a bit more “AGI-like” than 4.6 immediately (4.7 was a tool anyway and not appreciably sharper). 5.6 next, then what? [image]

tweets.author: @emollick
tweets.text: Here Opus 4.8 built and play-tested a new RPG in Claude Code, including 3 PDF manuals and adventures, playtest notes, a website, and a playable solo adventure - then put it all on Netlify. No feedback from me at all.  [image]

sub_items.title: Anthropic says it expects Mythos-class models to be available to all customers “in the coming weeks” following the development of stronger safeguards
Anthropic adds dynamic workflows to Claude Code, enabling hundreds of subagents to run in parallel for complex engineering tasks such as framework migrations

top news.title: Anthropic raised a $65B Series H at a $965B post-money valuation, overtaking OpenAI's $852B valuation, and says its revenue run rate crossed $47B this month

tweets.author: @mikeisaac
tweets.text: new numbers from ANT too: company says its revenue run rate surpassed $47 billion earlier this month. that is an enormous surge of nearly four times its run rate from just three months ago

tweets.author: @edels0n
tweets.text: $65B private round More than double the size of the largest IPO ever

tweets.author: @edzitron
tweets.text: Round is actually $50 billion, this also included $15 billion from Amazon and Google that was raised in April btw. Google also, per CNBC, actually invested at a $380 billion valuation.  [image]

top news.title: Dell reports Q1 revenue up 88% YoY to $43.84B, vs. $35.43B est., and forecasts FY 2027 revenue above estimates; DELL jumps 38%+ after hours

tweets.author: @benbajarin
tweets.text: Dell + NVIDIA has very similar dynamics to Dell + Intel in the early PC days. But as I outlined here, Dell's storage business is VERY well positioned within their entire infrastructure solutions.

tweets.author: @ljkawa
tweets.text: Dell's AI server business didn't exist until late 2023 as a business segment. Its sales are now larger than Dell's entire Client Solutions Group (its foundational, mature PC-focused division)  $DELL [image]
